formation.note: Date of the proposal submission to DESY management, used as the formation date; the paper describes the Frascati discussion meeting of 1-5 March 1976, where the physicists who became JADE's founders presented their detector ideas before joining forces on a single proposal.
formation.quote: August JADE proposal submitted to DESY management

intervals.label: PETRA data taking
intervals.locator: Bethke & Wagner (2022), Table 2 (1979, March); end from Table 2 (1986, Nov. 3)
intervals.note: First data (single electron beam) in March 1979; a beam loss damaged the tracking chamber on 26 March 1979 and data taking resumed in June 1979 after repair. End = 3 November 1986 "shutdown of PETRA and the JADE experiment".
intervals.quote: March first data recorded (single e− -beam, Ebeam = 11.3 GeV)

intervals.label: PETRA shut down; experiment ended
intervals.note: JADE data were later preserved and revived; analyses continued until 2012 and data and software were released in 2022 via the CERN Open Data portal.
intervals.quote: Nov. 3 shutdown of PETRA and the JADE experiment

summary.plain: The Japanese, German and British groups that built and ran the JADE detector at DESY's PETRA collider; the collaboration name is formed from JApan, Deutschland and England.
summary.technical: JADE collaboration founded by J. Heintze (Heidelberg), M. Koshiba (Tokyo) and S. Orito; the groups of Heidelberg, DESY (with Hamburg), Tokyo, Daresbury (later Rutherford Appleton), Lancaster and Manchester signed the 1976 proposal; later joined by a US group; spokesperson R. Felst throughout.
